Name: Winter Star Spouse
Author: drbirbdev
Description:
See Configs to adjust chance of spouse being your gift giver/receiver.

Does not work if you have multiple girlfriends/boyfriends (shame on you), but probably works with Free Love main spouse.[i][size=5][size=4]

How To Install[/size]
[/size][/i][size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the WinterStarSpouse folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installing on an existing file, new profession should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android (probably).
